column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-dev-activities-v2 - proposed activities (one item per activity, comments embedded). Every activity carries a groupId so feeds stay isolated per household. updatedAt absent on legacy rows falls back to createdAt in API projections; liveStartedAt is set only while the activity is live. Comment likes live in the -comment-likes table. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so reading a household's feed is one Query and no row can be addressed from another household. The -v2 suffix is historical: this replaced an id-keyed table of the same name, which a key-schema change could not alter in place.
